title: Cantilever beam impact
line: A transient FEA study of a steel cantilever beam struck by a 1 kN pulse.
description: Transient response of a steel cantilever beam (1000 x 100 x 100 mm) fixed at one end. A 1 kN half-sine force pulse lasting 6 ms, generated by the MATLAB function impactPulse.m, strikes the free end. The study integrates the response over 30 ms, about two and a half periods of the first bending mode.
thumbnailAlt: Tip displacement of a steel cantilever beam after an impact pulse, solved in RunMat
